description: This source file implements the WebAudioPlayerClient class, which handles notifications of WebAudioPlayer state changes and communicates these events via IPC to other components. It includes functions for converting internal WebAudioPlayerState enums to protocol buffer message enums, and methods for sending state change events.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
classes.description: Handles IPC notifications for WebAudioPlayer state changes, encapsulating the player handle and IPC client.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WebAudioPlayerClient with a handle and IPC client.

methods.name: notifyState
methods.description: Sends a WebAudioPlayerState change event via IPC.
